script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Psychological
Theme: identity

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

A dimly lit room. A TABLE with several JARS of various sizes and MAGNIFYING GLASSES on it. A middle-aged MAN, JAMES, hunched over a magnifying glass, scrutinizing the contents of one jar.

Suddenly, the door swings open. JAMES jumps up, startled. A YOUNG WOMAN, ANNA, enters.

ANNA
(softly)
James, you're still up?

JAMES
(nervously)
I couldn't sleep. I needed to... focus.

Anna's eyes widen as she takes in the room.

ANNA
(confused)
Focus on what exactly?

James hesitates before answering.

JAMES
My past.

INT. JAMES'S STUDY - DAY

James sits at his large wooden desk, surrounded by stacks of books and papers. Anna enters, carrying a tray with tea. She sets it down and sits across from him.

ANNA
What's in the jars, James?

James looks away, embarrassed.

JAMES
Mementos. Keepsakes. Memories.

Anna studies him for a moment before speaking.

ANNA
Why are you so fixated on your past? Can't you let go and move on?

James looks back at her, intense.

JAMES
I can't, Anna. My past defines me. It's a part of who I am.

INT. ANNA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Anna lies in bed, staring at the ceiling. She reaches for her phone and calls James.

ANNA
(into phone)
James, meet me at the park tomorrow. I want to show you something.

INT. PARK - DAY

James and Anna meet near a pond. Anna leads him to a bench and hands him a small, leather-bound BOOK.

ANNA
This is my journal. I wrote in it every day for years. Read it and tell me what you think.

James flips through the pages, reading aloud. He stops on a particular entry.

JAMES
(reading)
"Today I discovered who I truly am. I am not the person I thought I was. I am stronger, braver, kinder. I am capable of love and forgiveness."

James looks up at Anna, confused.

JAMES
But this isn't about you. What does this have to do with me?

Anna smiles sadly.

ANNA
It's about us, James. I want you to see that you're more than just your past. You're capable of growth and change.

INT. JAMES'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

James sits at his desk, staring at the journal. He starts to write in it, his pen moving quickly across the page.

INT. ANNA'S APARTMENT - DAY

Anna enters her apartment to find James sitting on her couch, looking through her photo albums.

ANNA
(surprised)
James, what are you doing?

JAMES
I wanted to see who you were before you met me. I wanted to know the person you were when you discovered who you truly are.

Anna smiles and sits down next to him.

ANNA
You're learning to let go, James. That's a good thing.

James looks at her, a new understanding in his eyes.

JAMES
Thank you, Anna. I'm learning to be more than just my past.

FADE OUT.

---

END OF SCREENPLAY.
